name: The King's Guild
description: Master artisans of the King's Guild each ply a different trade in a different quarter of the city. Work out who's who.
clues: Riverside goes with at least one of Beatrix or Tanner.
Either Millpond goes with Weaver or someone in the Ironmongers' Guild goes with Riverside.
Exactly one of these is true: Cedric goes with Oldwall; Godfrey goes with Weaver; Tanner goes with Southgate.
Cedric, Potter, and Southgate belong to different artisans.
Exactly one of the artisan in Bridgegate and the artisan in Riverside belongs to the Clothiers' Guild.
More members of the River Ward are in the Ironmongers' Guild than members of the Market Ward.
Between Blacksmith and Weaver, one goes with Aldric and the other with Riverside.
Godfrey does not belong to the River Ward.
